formatDescription: A FlowJo Workspace File is a lightweight XML-based document that saves your gating hierarchies, statistics, compensation matrices, and report layouts without containing the actual raw data files. It relies on pointers to original Flow Cytometry Standard (.fcs) data files rather than embedding them.
